entities.summary: María Natalia Lafourcade Silva is a Mexican singer. Her music combines elements of pop rock, jazz, and folk, characterized by poetic lyrics and her distinctive lyric soprano voice. She is regarded as one of the most influential Latin music artists of the 21st century. In 2025, Billboard named her one of the best female Latin pop artists of all time.
